titre: Control test n°2 — English (4th year primary, first year)

exercices.enonce:
Read and answer.

This is my family. My father is Sami. My mother is Leila. I have one brother. His name is Omar.

1) Who is the father? .......... (2 points)
2) Who is the mother? .......... (1 points)
3) What is the brother's name? .......... (1 points)

Family words. Complete with: father — mother — brother — sister.
1) My .......... is a woman.
2) My .......... is a man.
3) My .......... is a boy.
4) My .......... is a girl.

1) Circle the family words: (2 points)
mother — red — brother — book — sister.
2) Complete: (2 points)
.......... is my father. (This / A)   I have .......... brother. (a number)

About your family. Complete. (4 points)
My father's name is .......... .
My mother's name is .......... .

My body and my clothes.
1) Complete with: eyes - nose - mouth. (3 points)
a) I see with my .......... .
b) I smell with my .......... .
c) I eat with my .......... .
2) Circle the clothes word: (1 point)
( dress / apple / dog )
